# docs/memory/waf/

<!-- Generated by php tools/memory_index.php from the frontmatter of each file, except the key rules between the two marker lines, which are written by hand. -->

Firewall (waf.php): rules, bans, rate limits, bots, logs, security headers.

## Key rules

<!-- key-rules:start -->
- Keep `waf.php`, `includes/geo.php` and `includes/db_guard.php` free of `functions.php`, `lang()`, sessions and HTTP calls: `router.php` runs them first (`waf-architecture-and-phases.md`).
- Keep signature scanning in the init phase and the `waf_run()` body fail-open in its try/catch: a firewall that breaks a request is worse than none (`waf-architecture-and-phases.md`).
- Never reorder the bot classification: attack tools first, the operator's Blocked Bots after the built-in lists, residual signal last (`waf-score-calibration-and-bot-order.md`).
- Exempt by path (robots.txt, `.well-known/`) or by running script (`health.php`), never by query string; they skip the bot policy, never the IP list or rate limits (`waf-path-exemption-and-robots.md`).
- Take the visitor's address only from `waf_client_ip()` and count per `waf_ip_subject()` (the /64 for IPv6); never copy the proxy logic (`waf-ip-subject-ipv6-64.md`).
- Refuse only through `waf_deny()`, whose mode check keeps Monitor mode's promise; only the operator's IP list blocks in every mode (`waf-kill-switch-and-monitor-mode.md`).
- Give every endpoint that accepts a password `pg_login_throttle_guard()` and `pg_login_record_failure()`; the throttle works with the firewall off (`waf-login-throttle.md`).
- Log every new limit or gate with `waf_log_event()` and every new deny path in `data/firewall.log`; a protection that refuses silently is half a protection (`waf-fail2ban-log.md`).
- Write a new IP column as `VARCHAR(45)` and a ban as one atomic `INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE` (`waf-ipv6-ban-column-width.md`).
- Count aggregated log rows with `SUM(hit_count)`, never `COUNT(*)`, and cap the table with `MAX(id)` (`waf-log-aggregation-and-cap.md`).
- Send a visitor to a sign-in screen only for a page opening: `get_file.php` goes through `get_file_sign_in_redirect()`, which answers a sub-resource fetch (`waf_fetch_is_subresource()`) with 403, and such a fetch of a sign-in screen is not counted on the sensitive allowance (`waf-subresource-sign-in-fetches.md`).
- Register a rate refusal with the burst flag (`waf_register_offence($ip, $score, $blocking, true)`: one offence per subject and minute) and a signature hit, an attack tool or a wrong key without it; never auto-ban an address staff signed in from (`waf-offence-fold-and-staff-address.md`).
- Gate a new per-address counter or ban on `waf_ip_is_counted()` (not infrastructure, not a private or reserved address; the lists still apply), and go by `waf_script_name()`, never `basename(SCRIPT_NAME)`: the web root's `index.php` is the router (`waf-counter-subjects-and-endpoints.md`).
<!-- key-rules:end -->

## Files

- form-captcha-providers.md: Turnstile and hCaptcha beside the built-in maths question - where the keys live, render and server check, fail closed, staff-only exemption, CSP and the cookie notice.
- form-submission-checks.md: custom_form.php protections other than the limits - order of the checks, signed fill time and its retry rule, StopForumSpam over https, the staff-only exemption and the gaps still open.
- form-submission-limits.md: custom_form.php per visitor address, per e-mail and per domain limits in waf_rate - atomic counting before the hook, inbox folding, settings, why the domain limit is off by default, known weak spots.
- waf-ai-bots-ranges.md: AI bot policy: training crawlers vs user fetchers, waf_ai_bots() verification by published IP ranges (waf_bot_ranges), verdict ladder, refresh path (2026.4.4).
- waf-architecture-and-phases.md: waf.php structure: standalone module (no functions.php, no HTTP), what runs in the router vs init phase, signature scanning only in init, fail-open, waf_client_ip(), upgrade compatibility.
- waf-ban-ladder.md: waf_auto_ban() escalation ladder: hit_count is the number of bans, 60-240-960-3840-10080 min, cap waf_auto_ban_max_minutes, expired rows kept for ladder memory.
- waf-ban-shield-mirror.md: The ban shield mirror data/temp/ban_shield.txt: line types B/P/A/L, the ban's end on B lines, who writes it, staleness asymmetry, allow-list lines, the shield's page, shield_pending.log and drain.
- waf-bot-policy-credential-endpoints.md: Which endpoints skip the WAF bot policy because they admit a caller by its credential (integration, mcp, oauth, workspace_ical, feed, marketplace_webhook), why, where the return sits, why not api.php.
- waf-cidr-prefix-validation.md: waf_ip_in_cidr() / waf_ip_matches_simple() must reject empty or non-numeric CIDR prefixes (ctype_digit); the (int) cast bug that banned everyone.
- waf-connection-held-work-and-silent-rejection.md: Endpoints holding a DB connection while waiting on external services, rate limits vs connection-seconds, and always logging rejections.
- waf-counter-subjects-and-endpoints.md: A private visitor address is not counted, the web root's index.php is the router, shipworks.php and workspace_guest.php are credential endpoints, the api.php allowance exempts staff only
- waf-country-restriction.md: Firewall country restriction (waf_handle_country(), 2026.4.10 step 10.2): place in waf_run(), allow/block, unknown country, exemptions, not an offence, save guard, sign-in screens kept to the panel.
- waf-csp-builtin-and-reporter.md: Built-in CSP policy (learning mode), waf_csp_policy() allowlist rule for new panel external resources, standalone csp_report.php collector and its storage.
- waf-db-guard-connection-failures.md: includes/db_guard.php rules: no fatal on DB connect error, only transient errors trip, guard runs before functions.php, circuit breaker with probing.
- waf-fail2ban-log.md: data/firewall.log fail2ban line format (path= on every line, the rule on BAN), which code paths write it, ip= is always the visitor address, rotation; a line for every new deny path.
- waf-false-positives-and-reference.md: view_waf_log.php likely false positive evidence and Allow/Remove actions, and the stored waf_reference() number shown on block pages.
- waf-geo-country-lookup.md: pg_geo_country() (includes/geo.php): edge header, server module or the site's DB-IP database, trust rules, no network call on a request; how data/geo is fetched, built and kept (includes/fn/geo.php).
- waf-inflight-request-cap.md: waf_inflight_* concurrent request cap on sensitive scripts: limit, 429 rule concurrent, file slots under data/temp, 120 s dead slot, fail-open, monitor mode.
- waf-ip-subject-ipv6-64.md: waf_ip_subject(): counters key on the address for IPv4 and on the /64 for IPv6; why IPv4 /24 is not aggregated; no /64 ban over an allowed address.
- waf-ipv6-ban-column-width.md: IP columns must be VARCHAR(45) (IPv6); how a VARCHAR(15) ip_address silently truncated and defeated bans; atomic waf_auto_ban ODKU (2026.2.7).
- waf-kill-switch-and-monitor-mode.md: waf_enabled=0 stops everything (absolute kill switch), monitor mode guarantee in waf_deny(), and the IP ban list applying in every mode (2026.3.1).
- waf-log-aggregation-and-cap.md: How waf_log aggregates by sha1 key + 5 min bucket, why the query string is excluded, waf_enforce_log_cap, use SUM(hit_count) (2026.2.6).
- waf-login-captcha.md: pg_login_captcha_* login question: when it appears, counter-driven decision, field name/id rule for password managers, wrong answer is not an offence.
- waf-login-throttle.md: Sign-in throttle (pg_login_throttle_* in includes/fn/auth.php): address and account counters in waf_rate, lockout bucket, own switch, which endpoints must count, the 429 answer and its log lines.
- waf-no-counters-before-db.md: Why a pre-DB request counter ("siege mode") was tried and removed; the design flaws to read before reintroducing one.
- waf-offence-fold-and-staff-address.md: A rate refusal registers one offence per subject and minute (the burst flag of waf_register_offence()), a staff sign-in's address is never auto-banned (would-ban), Release and Allow forget offences
- waf-outgoing-user-agent.md: Every outgoing cURL call must set CURLOPT_USERAGENT via pinegrap_user_agent(); an empty UA made one Pinegrap install block another as bot-empty.
- waf-path-exemption-and-robots.md: waf_is_excluded() matches the resolved script path only (never query, PATH_INFO or encoded tricks); /robots.txt, /.well-known/ and health.php are exempt from bot policy; feed readers are good bots.
- waf-score-calibration-and-bot-order.md: WAF signature score bands (thresholds 15/10/6, dead zone 7-9), targets key, and the fixed bot classification order with token-boundary residual signal.
- waf-secure-mode-enable-guard.md: firewall.save.php refuses to enable Secure Mode from a request not seen as HTTPS: predicate, messages, early return, why disabling is unchecked.
- waf-security-headers-hsts.md: Security headers are sent outside waf_run(), independent of the firewall switch; HSTS default off and its https gating; Permissions-Policy; nosniff and Referrer-Policy never doubled by server rules.
- waf-subresource-sign-in-fetches.md: A sub-resource fetch (image, style, script, font, media) of a protected file answers 403, never the sign-in redirect; such a fetch of a sign-in screen is not counted as sensitive (#1989)
